definitions.explanation: The liquid produced in the mouth. A basic word that Japanese children learn early but which may not appear in formal textbooks.

examples.japanese: つば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧な。
つば⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んだ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧つば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み{込|こ}んだ→飲み込む：04403_nomikomu⟧。
examples.english: I was nervous and swallowed my saliva.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {唾|つば}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- つば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to spit)
- つば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to swallow one's saliva - often from nervousness or anticipation)
- つば⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (spit flies - when speaking emphatically)
- つば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to put one's spit on - to claim something, like licking food to claim it)

IDIOM: ⟦{眉|まゆ}→眉：04267_mayu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to put spit on one's eyebrows) means to be skeptical, based on a belief that this protected against fox possession.

FORMAL TERM: ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧ is the formal/medical term for saliva.
